header.name: Digital Processor Design
header.description: This course will introduce students to the evolution of processor architecture with focus on RISC V Processors. Various building blocks of RISC V processors along with their implemention using System Verilog will be discussed. Various processor architectures such as single, multi cycle and pipelined versions will be realized using system verilog and compared in terms of their performance.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to design and implement Sequential and combinational circuits using System Verilog

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to design and implement Single Cycle RISC V Processor using System Verilog

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to compare Single Cycle, Multiple cycle and pipelined architectures of RISC V processors

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Introduction to Vivado and Combinational circuit using System Verilog
Design of Single Cycle Processor building blocks (Phase 1)

lecture_topics: Processor Microarchitectures: Deep pipelines, Branch Predictions, Out-of-order processing, Superscalar processors, Multi-threading
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Design of Single Cycle Processor building blocks (Phase 2)

lecture_topics: Evolution of RISC V Architecture in last decade
Future research directions (Case Studies of Architectures and open source tools)
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: End-to-end Design of single and multi cycle processor

resources.title: Engineering Circuit analysis, William H. Hayt Jr., Jack E. Kemmerly and Steven M. Durbin, 8thEdition, Tata McGraw Hill
S. Harris and D. Harris, “Digital Design and Computer Architecture: RISC V Edition”, Morgan Kauffmann, 2022.
D. Patterson and J. Hennessy, “Computer Organization and Design: RISC V Edition”, Morgan Kauffmann, 2018.
